versions.changelog:
v1.1.1: 修复 SkillSpector 全部 8 个 finding

【Vague Triggers x4】移除 SKILL.md 中所有 '用户说 xxx' 的宽泛触发句式，替换为精确的 'when to use' / when NOT to use 使用场景说明（搜索/抓取/发现页面/爬取整站）

【Missing User Warnings High - Interact】SKILL.md 交互操作节增加 ⚠️ 风险警告，要求操作前必须先向用户确认

【Missing User Warnings x3 - Search/Scrape/Extract】
- SKILL.md 顶部增加 ⚠️ 数据外发提醒（所有数据发送至 Firecrawl API）
- firecrawl_wrapper.py 新增 _warn_data_transmission() 函数，scrape/search/interact/extract/crawl/map 全部 6 个命令在发送请求前先打印数据外发警告到 stderr

v1.1.0: Full Firecrawl capability integration. Added: interact (page operations like click/search/fill forms), extract (AI-powered structured data extraction), proactive next-step guidance after every response, crawl async progress polling, user-friendly error messages for 402/429/network errors. SKILL.md rewritten with complete behavior rules for all 6 capabilities.

v1.0.0: Firecrawl simplified wrapper for non-technical users. Scrape any webpage, search the web, map site structure, and crawl entire sites — all in plain language. Powered by Firecrawl (https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl). Zero configuration: works with Firecrawl's free tier out of the box. Optional API key support for heavy users. Pure Python stdlib, no dependencies.
